cases.disposition_reason: CommonArgs::level, CommonArgs::charset, and CommonArgs::motion in src/cli.rs apply an explicit flag before detection. ColorLevel::detect in src/theme.rs selects Mono when NO_COLOR is non-empty, otherwise TrueColor because the harness sets COLORTERM=truecolor. Charset::detect honours JUNIE_TUI_GLYPHS, and an explicit --glyphs wins. Motion::resolve in src/motion.rs keeps an explicit value. Motion::env_requests_reduced treats a non-empty value other than 0 as reduced. The variables are SHOWCASE_NO_MOTION, TABLEPRO_NO_MOTION, HOLLA_NO_MOTION, and JACKIN_NO_MOTION in each binary's main.rs. Measured on the reference showcase, the focused ▎ cell is Rgb(72, 224, 84) for --color truecolor, Indexed(78) for 256, Indexed(10) for 16, and Indexed(15) for none. --glyphs unicode paints ▎› Overview and --glyphs ascii paints |› Overview, from Glyphs::UNICODE.focus_bar and Glyphs::ASCII.focus_bar in src/theme.rs. JUNIE_TUI_GLYPHS=ascii with no flag matches the ascii paint, and --glyphs unicode still paints ▎. NO_COLOR, via launch color nocolor and no --color, paints that accent cell as Default and paints no RGB cell on showcase, holla, and tablepro, and paints the K of jackin's Knock caption as Default instead of Rgb(255, 255, 255). --color truecolor together with NO_COLOR=1 still selects TrueColor, so the showcase chrome in src/bin/showcase/app.rs reads truecolor. Crossterm 0.29 writes no SGR while NO_COLOR is set, and src never calls force_color_output, so those cells stay Default and the accent is not Rgb(72, 224, 84). SHOWCASE_NO_MOTION=1 holds the progress spinner on ⠋, matching --motion reduced. --motion full and the value 0 move off ⠋. HOLLA_NO_MOTION=1 omits discovering, matching reduced. --motion full and 0 paint discovering, from sources_for in src/bin/holla/domain/parity.rs. JACKIN_NO_MOTION=1 paints Knock, knock, operator. and Continue, matching reduced in src/bin/jackin/rain.rs. --motion full and 0 paint Skip. TABLEPRO_NO_MOTION=1 holds the connect spinner on ⠋. --motion full and 0 cycle it. The 120×40 and 80×24 frames are one showcase session launched with --color truecolor and --motion reduced, then resized, with no nudge. Both show Tokens and principles behind every component and the ▎ cell Rgb(72, 224, 84).
cases.action_sequence: Launch with each colour and glyph value, with NO_COLOR, and with each application NO_MOTION variable.
cases.expected_results: The rendered level matches the winning value.
